speaker: Doctor
text:
Good morning, I see you have been experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms can indicate a serious underlying condition; to narrow this down, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have recently traveled or lost weight unintentionally?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, ESR, CRP, TB_IgG

speaker: Doctor
text: The initial inflammatory markers and blood work are normal, which is interesting given your night sweats and weight loss. Have you noticed any specific cough, hemoptysis, or loss of appetite in the past few months? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: That is surprising given your supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and B-symptoms; a normal chest X-ray and blood work makes typical bacterial infection or malignancy less likely. Have you recently had close contact with anyone diagnosed with tuberculosis, and do you have any history of immunosuppression?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.
